column5: Routed 2026-08-25 at /play/towers; was a 1024x880 dialog at scale 0.348 (Bet 112.7x18.1, board tiles 46.9x16.4). Measured at 375: scale 1, Bet 275x52, currency 91.4x44, all controls reachable. CATALOG GAP, partly closed: the ENTIRE 10130-* cluster was missing from every nodes.txt in this catalog, not just one id - while 10120-* was present. Added the two I verified live via get_metadata: 10130-14013 (356x777.33, 'Frame 1000004105' - the bet panel in AUTO mode with Advanced EXPANDED: Manual|Auto, Bet amount, Balance, Difficulty, 'Number of Bets:', an 'Advanced' label + input/toggle, On Win / On Loss (Reset | Increase By), Stop on Win / Stop on Loss, CTA) and 10130-14171 (375x1605, the mobile page). RESOLVED 2026-08-26: all five were measured live by the catalog lane (skai-ui 2099577) and none is missing. THREE ARE TOP-LEVEL and are now catalogued: 10130-13720 'Frame 270' 356x621 (desktop bet panel), 10130-14802 'Frame 1000004291' 347x777 and 10130-14946 'Frame 1000004292' 347x621 (mobile bet panels); all three classify kind=non-screen, correctly - they are panel fragments, not 'Skai >' screens. TWO ARE CHILDREN of 10130-13720 and are deliberately NOT in nodes.txt, whose contract is top-level children of a page: 10130-13760 'Frame 275' 324x16 (the Balance row, depth 2) and 10130-13771 'Frame 1000004102' 324x66 (Difficulty, depth 1). Code may cite a child id - TowerBetPanel cites 13760 for the balance row it draws - but a nodes list may not. ★ THE FOUR PANEL FRAMES ARE TWO STATES x TWO BREAKPOINTS, which is the fact that settles report 176075a8: desktop 13720 (621h, Advanced off) / 14013 (777.33h, on), mobile 14946 (621h, off) / 14802 (777h, on). The ~156px the taller pair adds is exactly the On Win / On Loss / Stop-on block, so 'Advanced' is a TOGGLE with two drawn states at both widths, never a button. ★ 10130-14013 CONFIRMS report 176075a8's triage against the live frame rather than by inference: the 'Advanced' the reporter read as a missing button is a LABEL + TOGGLE ROW (10130:14102 -> text 10130:14103 plus input/toggle 10130:14104) INSIDE the auto panel, not an action button on the manual panel. ★ 10130-14171 also confirms two things asserted elsewhere: its Community-wins rows ALL read 'Blackjack' (10130:14418/14432/14446/14460/14474) with named players and dollar payouts, so transcribing that section would ship fabricated wins; and it carries 'Try Blackjack in Fun Mode' (10130:14394), which Casey's no-practice-mode rule forbids. Its board is 4 columns x 9 rows - the same 9x4 report 07036f65 describes, which is a DIFFICULTY setting, not a design (the app renders 10x3 at Medium). Bet panel balance row now draws the frame's circled-plus (10130:13760) instead of a refresh glyph, inert like Crash/Dice/Roulette/Fortune Wheel - skai-gaming 04cd2a2, NOT YET DEPLOYED (report 793560fd claim 2). CORRECTION to the line that follows: a 375x1605 mobile frame DID land (10130:14171, plus bet panels 10130:14946 and 10130:14802), titled 'Blackjack' like its siblings - identify by page name and H1, never by frame title. NOTE: Towers has no mobile Figma frame - routing fixes the scale defect at every width, but what the mobile page should LOOK like is still design-blocked, so this row can never reach `done` on the current design set.
